rationale: C02 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It concerns the same Kaakaukukui–Honolulu harbor-improvement project and uses the same unusual two-part mechanism: restoration and title transfer occur automatically only after the Territory performs detailed replacement work and the responsible federal authority certifies completion. Numerous operative details recur, including Territory-funded plans subject to federal approval, replacement of facilities and standard equipment, rights of entry, concurrence in contractor acceptance, identical twelve- and thirty-month deadlines, and final certification. C17 and C11 share related Hawaii land-transfer language, but neither approaches C02's distinctive administrative machinery and parallel sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Upon the fulfillment of the conditions precedent specified in Part II ... and the certification thereof ... and without further act, the possession, use, and control ... shall be restored ... and title ... shall be transferred
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Upon the fulfillment of the conditions precedent specified in Part II ... and the certification thereof ... and without further act, the possession, use, and control ... shall be restored ... and title ... shall be transferred
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim conditional restoration and title-transfer formula, organized into the same Parts I and II.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Territory of Hawaii shall remove ... or ... reconstruct ... structures now situate on the land described in Part I
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Territory of Hawaii shall replace ... facilities ... [and] completely raze the existing warehouse
shared_material.explanation: Both condition the land transfer on Territory-financed relocation, reconstruction, replacement, or demolition of federal facilities displaced by the harbor project.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Detailed plans and specifications ... shall receive the approval of the Commissioner before the start of work ... All expenses ... shall be borne by the Territory of Hawaii.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Territory of Hawaii shall bear all expenses ... final plans and specifications ... shall be approved by the Department of the Army before the start of construction
shared_material.explanation: Same plans, prior federal approval, and Territory-cost machinery, adapted to a different supervising agency.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall commence the work ... within twelve months and shall complete it within thirty months from the date of this order
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall commence construction and alteration ... within twelve months, and shall complete ... within thirty months, from the date of this order
shared_material.explanation: The identical pair of performance deadlines is distinctive corroborating evidence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: At the request of the Territory ... prior to final acceptance ... shall inform the Territory as to whether he concurs in such final acceptance
shared_material.parent_excerpt: At the request of the Territory ... prior to final acceptance ... shall advise the Territory ... whether it concurs in such final acceptance

shared_material.child_excerpt: When the Territory of Hawaii has satisfactorily completed all work ... and has fulfilled all conditions precedent ... the Commissioner shall so certify
shared_material.parent_excerpt: When the Territory of Hawaii has completed to the satisfaction of the Department of the Army all the work ... the Department shall so certify
shared_material.explanation: Same completion, acceptance, and certification endpoint, with the Immigration Commissioner substituted for the Army.
